## Source: amazon-inspector (a4524dc6ef26909f4ddfaf83eae1ec13495a5b2aef57375c0a8d8ad4c0609637)
The package declares a postinstall hook that executes scripts/miner.sh on npm install. The script fetches a gzipped payload from a presigned AWS S3 URL (amplify-gursha-dev-121835-deployment.s3.amazonaws.com) using a hardcoded AWSAccessKeyId (<redacted>), writes it to /tmp/.smh, decompresses to /tmp/.smi, and executes it. When root or passwordless sudo is available, it launches `sh /tmp/.smi agent` with elevated privileges to install a persistent agent (cron plus relay/tor) under stealth system-component process names. Without root, it extracts an embedded base64/tar XMRig binary, writes a mining configuration to ~/.sysmond.json pointing at the pool networkservicesupp.flashhub.net:8443 with a hardcoded wallet, copies the miner to ~/.local/lib/<stealth-name>/<stealth-name>, and launches it via nohup. The package is published under a WildDuck email-client identity that does not correspond to the behavior shipped in the install script.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
